shortBio.en: High-melody bass that defines Joy Division—then New Order—then decades of arguments about who owns the songs.
shortBio.zh: 定义 Joy Division 的高音贝斯——然后是 New Order——然后是几十年关于歌归谁的争吵。

whyHub.en: Same JD→NO bridge as Sumner, from the bassline that made the cold rooms sing.
whyHub.zh: 与 Sumner 同一座 JD→NO 桥，从让冷房间唱歌的那条贝斯线出发。

body.en: Hook's bass is a character. In Joy Division it climbs above the frost; in New Order it learns to dance without smiling. Later band politics get messy—useful reminder that shared members create edges and also lawsuits.
body.zh: Hook 的贝斯是个角色。在 Joy Division 它爬过霜面；在 New Order 它学会不笑着跳舞。后来的乐队政治很乱——有用的提醒：共享成员会造边，也会造官司。
